correctness.rationale: Condition on the complete-kill event \(E_n\), which fixes the \(n\)th label to rank one in both independent coordinate permutations. Relative ranks of the first \(n-1\) labels remain uniform. After ordering by the first coordinate, current Pareto minima are exactly left-to-right minima of a uniform permutation. Their independent sequential relative-rank indicators have probabilities \(1/j\), so the generating function is \(z(z+1)\cdots(z+n-2)/(n-1)!\), yielding the unsigned-Stirling formula. Fixed-degree elementary-symmetric asymptotics give \(C_{n,k}\sim n^{-3}(\log n)^{k-1}/(k-1)!\), and Fill's exact remainder formula then gives the stated factor \(1/4\). A fresh recurrence replay through \(n=19\) verified row normalization \(\sum_k C_{n,k}=n^{-2}\); this finite check is supplementary.
residual_risks: The exact law is bivariate and uses independent continuous coordinates; no uniform-in-k or higher-dimensional analogue is proved.
